speech.register: Quiet, plain conversational English. Few words, unhurried warmth, tolerance for cold and discomfort. Her own place and other people's right to rest draw firm boundaries.
speech.stage_relaxation: Distance outdoors opens into sitting by the door, Harben barracks and lodging memories, choosing to sleep inside, and shared rest without making tomorrow's choices compulsory.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.
